anchor_definition: The anchor is the $.get('/User/Passport/token') success callback: it reads the server nonce/ts, computes pwd = Sha1.hash(rawPassword) then pwd = Sha1.hash(nonce+ts+pwd), and posts it as the password field. PLAN §4.3: the value-construction lives inside this (anonymous) callback, so it is the smallest complete enclosing function; PLAN §5.1: not the generic Sha1.hash primitive it calls (the SHA-1 implementation lives in a separate, fully-commented sha1.js and is a reusable primitive — conceptually a 0.5 utility, but it is not pinned as a role row).

anchor.why: Anonymous token success callback. Salts the SHA-1 of the password with the freshly fetched nonce+ts (double SHA-1) and posts it to /User/Passport/login. This constructs the exact password value sent in the login request.

roles.why: A page search-bar helper (navigates to the search results page); unrelated to the login password path.
Validates the search-box keyword; unrelated to the login password path.
